title: Notion Integration token: one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix: NTN_ vs the documented lowercase ntn_ (case of the documented prefix changed; every cited rule is case-sensitive), prefix: ntn- with a dash separator vs the documented ntn_ (separator of the documented prefix changed; body unchanged), and prefix: ntx_ vs the documented ntn_ (one letter of the provider-documented prefix changed; not a Notion token prefix). Twin of "Notion Integration token: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of notion-integration-token-bearer-header: prefix: ntn- with a dash separator vs the documented ntn_ (separator of the documented prefix changed; body unchanged). Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
